_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

card_product.name: IOB RuPay Platinum Credit Card
card_product.point_value_baseline_basis: IOB credit card page (last updated 5 Nov 2026), Features of Rupay Credit Card, and IOB RuPay credit card FAQ Q27 (last updated 7 Oct 2026): each reward point has a value of ₹0.25; redeemable for merchandise, gift card, travel, entertainment, recharge and DTH; minimum 750 points to redeem. The page says redeem "before the expiry of reward point" but gives no expiry period.

eligibility_engine.notes: IOB RuPay FAQ (7 Oct 2026): all IOB customers can apply; NRIs holding an Indian passport are eligible; for a CIBIL score below 650 a limit against a deposit with 10% margin is offered; no third-party guarantee; documents are the application form, income proof (ITR, salary slip or Form 16) and KYC. IOB page credit limits for RuPay Platinum: minimum ₹60,000, maximum under ₹2,00,000 for the public (under ₹1,50,000 for staff).

action.reason: One reward point for every ₹100 spent on RuPay Platinum, each point worth ₹0.25 (0.25% back). Points are given for transactions of ₹100 and above made at POS or e-commerce (IOB RuPay FAQ Q27; IOB credit card page).

components: 5% of the billed transactions (purchases and cash advances) plus interest and charges applied plus applicable GST, minimum ₹100 (MITC)

annual_fee_waiver.evaluation_condition: IOB MITC (PDF created 20 Aug 2026), fee table: RuPay Platinum joining fee NIL, annual fee ₹250 + GST, minimum spends for annual fee reversal ₹1,00,000. The MITC does not say which period the spend is counted over or which categories are excluded; card_anniversary_year is assumed.

lifestyle_and_network_benefits.label: Complimentary international airport lounge access (per calendar year)

insurance_and_protection.claim_condition: Personal accident cover provided free by NPCI under the RuPay insurance programme (FY 2025-26 documents linked on the IOB page); the amount changes with NPCI terms.

direct_options.channel: IOB credit card rewards (merchandise, gift card, travel, entertainment, recharge, DTH)

value.research_method: direct review of official issuer/partner pages and published terms; no browser automation response assumed
value.effective_date_caveats: Official product page and bank schedule are not a current card-specific MITC/KFS bundle; verify current fee schedule, reward exclusions and insurance certificate before publication.
fact_claims: IOB identifies RuPay Platinum as its premium RuPay credit-card variant. Issuer lists one reward point per ₹100 spent; each point value ₹0.25; minimum redemption 750 points.
Official schedule lists joining fee nil and annual maintenance charge ₹250 from second year; AMC waiver when annual card spend exceeds ₹1,00,000. Other account-specific/salary concessions may vary.
IOB FAQ associates the Platinum RuPay card with ₹2 lakh NPCI personal accident cover, subject to NPCI terms and transaction eligibility; do not treat as unconditional insurance coverage.
IOB states staff/public credit limits differ; public stated range begins ₹60,000 and is below ₹2,00,000. Credit underwriting and assigned limit remain bank-discretionary.

value.research_method: issuer pages read in a real browser session or issuer PDFs read with pdftotext; no model summaries used as facts

sources.kind: IOB credit card MITC (2 pages, PDF created 20 Aug 2026, footer 5298_06/26): fee table lists RuPay Platinum and RuPay Select with no "proposed" marker; interest, forex, fuel waiver, late fee, MAD, add-on cards
IOB credit card page, last updated 5 Nov 2026: Features of Rupay Credit Card (earn rate, point value, minimum redemption, lounge, fuel waiver, NPCI personal accident cover)
IOB RuPay credit card FAQ, last updated 7 Oct 2026: "At present the following types of cards are issued by IOB: RuPay Classic, RuPay Platinum, RuPay Select"; reward Q27; eligibility
IOB credit card Schedule of Charges (PDF created 21 Oct 2023; one page): marks the RuPay variants "proposed to be launched", which the 2026 FAQ and MITC supersede

open_questions: AVAILABILITY resolved to on sale: the 7 Oct 2026 FAQ says RuPay Classic, Platinum and Select "are issued" at present, the Aug 2026 MITC lists them without the "proposed" asterisk, and the 5 Nov 2026 page describes them. The "proposed to be launched" note is on a 2023-dated Schedule of Charges. The FAQ says "all IOB customers can apply"; whether non-customers can apply is not stated, so application_mode "open" needs a person to confirm.

Reward rate is 1 point per ₹100 at ₹0.25 a point (0.25%), from the FAQ and the page. The page text under the Select column is headed "RuPay Platinum Credit Cards" (copy slip); the Select minimum redemption (1,000 points) and the FAQ ("Platinum, Signature and Select" earn 1 per ₹100) show it is the Select rule. The ₹100 minimum per transaction applies to POS and e-commerce spends; MCC exclusions and the points expiry period are not stated.
Annual fee reversal: ₹1,00,000 minimum spend for both RuPay Platinum and Select in the MITC fee table; the counting period and spend exclusions are not stated.
Lounge access: 1 domestic per quarter and 1 international per calendar year (Platinum), 2 and 2 (Select), from the page; no spend criteria, lounge list or network programme is stated.
Personal accident cover ₹2 lakh (Platinum) and ₹10 lakh (Select) is NPCI-provided and "changing time to time"; the FY 2025-26 NPCI documents linked from the page were not read.
The page lists a "Proposed Terms of EMI Option" (processing fee nil, 3% pre-closure, ₹3,000 minimum) that is marked proposed, so it is not modelled.
The IOB page also lists a "RuPay EKAA Super Premium Credit Card" (separate page), a card that is not in the catalogue or the research lists.
notes: Forex 2.5%; cash advance 2.25% (₹22.50 per ₹1,000) plus finance charge from the date of withdrawal, limit 40% of the card limit; interest 2.5% a month (30% a year), interest-free period 20 to 50 days; fuel surcharge 1%, waived for ₹400 to ₹5,000 transactions up to ₹250 per billing cycle; card replacement ₹100 + GST; over-limit fee ₹100; late fee ₹100 after 3 days past due; up to 4 add-on cards, no fee. The earlier ₹22.50 minimum cash fee was a restatement of 2.25% per ₹1,000 and is removed.
